name: Happy Princess
source:
Tomoyuki is a high school student. He temporarily lives alone because his parents are abroad on business. But, he enjoys his life with his childhood friends and classmates. 

One day, his peaceful life suddenly changes... Several girls appear in front of him, and tell him, "Choose one girl whom to marry!" He doesn't know what's going on, but his friends join this battle as well. Whom will he choose in the end...? 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
智之是一名高中生。父母因公出国期间，他暂时独自生活，但有青梅竹马与同学相伴，日子过得十分快乐。

一天，他平静的生活骤然改变……几名少女出现在面前，对他说：‘选一个人结婚吧！’智之完全不明白发生了什么，朋友们却也加入了这场争夺。最终，他会选择谁……？

[摘自ErogeShop]
